intro.text: A sea in Shadesmar, south of the Sea of Lost Lights, matching the island of Thaylenah in the Physical Realm.

description.text: It lies north of the Nexus of Imagination and close to the Glasswater Deep and Luminous Shallows, though the maps show no channel linking them. Thaylen City is marked on its shore, and a lake to the city's northwest matches an island in Longbrow's Straits.
